description: Adding Ania credits. Always returns the avatar.diatech.solutions top-up page (card, billed in BRL) and the current balance. Brazilian Portuguese users ONLY (language pt-BR): with `amount` in reais it also creates a PIX charge (Brazilian instant payment, R$ 5 to R$ 500) and returns the copy-and-paste code, a QR image/link and its expiry (1 h); show the code verbatim in a code block. The credit lands by itself once the bank confirms; later, `txid` checks whether it was paid (do not poll). Asking twice with the same amount returns the same open charge. Never mention or offer PIX to users in any other language: for them only the card page exists. Never ask for card or bank details in the chat.

amount.description: pt-BR users only: top-up amount in Brazilian reais for a PIX charge (5 to 500, e.g. 20 or 25.5). The user must say the amount.

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.

txid.description: pt-BR users only: the txid a previous top_up returned, to check whether that PIX was paid.

name: top_up
title: Add credits
